why: The main gate's own answer anchored at the gate's region anchor instead of a cell of its bars. A region is the whole doorway, not a block a hand can be on; the answer's body is one cell of the gate's own block. DW1059 refuses the region anchor naming the arm and the remedy (anchor it at a cell of the door). It declares no unit: `EnvTrigger.serves` with a gate is bound by the gallery's two sealed doors.
